VV has no Document Register; VV's Sheet panel renames (Panel__Sheet 146, 285) but has no order control; VV's Dev section offers Create, Duplicate and Delete only (DevMenu__Controls 101-103, 306). added_findings.title: Shared Whitecardopedia registrar lacks TV registrar 1.1.0-1.3.0: reloads over unsaved work and on a first install
added_findings.detail: VV runs under Whitecardopedia's registrar (VV index.html 44). Its controllerchange bridge (registrar 110-150) reloads the page once per session whenever a worker takes control, deferring only for Na__LoadWatchdog__IsLoadingActive. TV's registrar 1.1.0 (19-Sep) also waits while the Layout Editor has unsaved work (window.TrueVision__Pwa__HasUnsavedWork, published by AutoSave); 1.2.0 (19-Sep, TV v2.75.0) does not reload on a FIRST install, so a first visit (and the first launch of an installed iPad icon) does not load the model twice; 1.3.0 (29-Sep) registers with updateViaCache 'none' so a token bump is seen at once. The WCP registrar has none of the three (it registers with { scope } only, line 195; its log stops at 1.2.0 of 26-Jun). VV deliberately did not publish an unsaved flag on the belief that it has no worker (ledger row 236; VV AutoSave 48-53). Consequences: every first VV visit loads the model, reloads and loads it again; and any token bump (S10-F17) reloads open VV pages over unsaved sheets, under the close guard's leave-site question.
added_findings.recommendation: Port the three TV registrar changes into the WCP registrar (Vale's own infrastructure; WP-S10-15) and publish a neutral window.Na__Pwa__HasUnsavedWork from VV AutoSave (Na__LeAuto__HasUnsavedWork is already exported; the name per S03b D-S03b-07). Land before any token bump under D-S10-13. Test Whitecardopedia's own pages as well, since the registrar is shared.
added_findings.evidence: WCP Whitecardopedia__Pwa__ServiceWorker__Registrar__.js 28-46 (log), 110-150 (bridge), 195 (register); TV TrueVision__Pwa__ServiceWorker__Registrar__.js 36-62 (log 1.1.0-1.3.0), 125-200; TV AutoSave PublishUnsavedFlag ~560-570; VV AutoSave 48-53, 345, 433; ledger 135-173 and row 236; TV devlog v2.75.0 lines 9189, 9201
